name: Battle of Waterloo 2022

venue.name: [RIM Park](http://www.waterloo.ca/en/gettingactive/rimpark.asp)
venue.details: The competition takes place at Forbes Hall, on the second floor of RIM Park.

information: **Competitors may bring at most one (1) guest.** Competitors over the age of 18 are encouraged to come without a guest. Competitors **must** read the [COVID-19 Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BattleofWaterloo2022#19416-covid-19-safety-policy) prior to registering. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). Please see tabs for more information about the competition.
